correctness.rationale: Schur orthogonality and Pieri give |chi_m|²=sum_{i<=m}chi_(i,i). The independently established 1992 SU(3) triple-coupling formula specializes exactly to one plus the minimum of six slacks. Counting lattice triangles in the regimes r<=m and m<=r<=2m gives the two evaluated cubic branches and exact cutoff. Two finite sums yield the claimed saturated and diagonal moments. An explicit quadratic first difference has one positive root, giving the exact unimodal peak. The standalone checker additionally passed 540 comparisons, including independent Weyl-torus Haar constant-term calculations; those finite tests are not the general proof.

value.rationale: The natural Fourier decomposition of the fourth power of a single symmetric-power character produces a complete, positive two-parameter spectral profile with two explicit cubic branches, a strict finite-band cutoff at twice the degree, a 4/5 spectral-peak localization law, and closed moment invariants. This resolves the full mixed sixth-moment family with two repeated degrees, rather than a few arbitrary low-degree examples; it is an analytic benchmark for SU(3) central harmonic analysis.
